messages:
tom-cs: FYI ACME (acct acme-inc) opened an escalation — they're seeing a surge of 429s and high latency even though they have a Dedicated pool `acme-gold` provisioned. They say traffic appears to be routed to shared pools starting ~09:20 UTC. paste of sample request headers below.

jane-support: Uh. Do we have traces showing routing decision for those requests? Can they share a request id? :eyes:  

tom-cs: They gave one: req=01H9Q2X2Y3Z. Logs attached in their ticket. They also gave curl repro: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "x-redwood-tenant: acme-inc" \
  -H "x-redwood-routing: tier=gold, pool=acme-gold" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

kyle-sre: Putting the trace id into the control-plane logs... one sec. infra-bot, pull route-eval for req=01H9Q2X2Y3Z.

infra-bot: route-eval(req=01H9Q2X2Y3Z) => headers_parsed: {"x-redwood-tenant":"acme-inc","x-redwood-routing":"\"tier=\"gold\",pool=acme-gold"} ; evaluated_tier: "" ; selected_pool: shared-pool-3 ; applied_rate_limit: 60 RPS.

maria-eng: Wait, headers_parsed shows escaping/quote noise around the tier. Looks like the header value arrived with an extra quote character that broke the parser: `\"tier=\"gold\"` — that would cause tier eval to return empty and fall back to default routing.

ajane-support: (typo: meant @jane-support) Can we reproduce locally with the exact header string?

alex-runtime: I tried the exact string the bot shows and the routing parser currently splits on commas then parses key=val pairs. If a value contains stray quotes or encoding from some client lib, our parser silently ignores that pair. Repro snippet: 
```
python - <<EOF
s = '"tier="gold",pool=acme-gold'
# naive split => ['"tier="gold"','pool=acme-gold']
# parse first -> fails -> skip
EOF
```

kyle-sre: That explains why requests are landing on shared pools and hitting shared rate caps. ACME's Dedicated pool is fine, but their effective capacity is being reduced by routing fallback. Ouch.

tom-cs: ACME says they didn't change anything client-side. They do use a gateway (kong) that recently got a plugin upgrade yesterday. Could be the gateway adding quotes for multi-value headers.

maria-eng: This is a control-plane parsing edge-case. Impact: any header that contains embedded quotes or malformed quoting will drop the tier/pool pair and fallback to tenant default (which for some tenants is shared). That matches the timeline (09:20 when the gateway update rolled).

jane-support: Customer wants immediate mitigation — their service is user-facing. Recommended temporary steps?

kyle-sre: Two immediate mitigations: 1) Add a tenant-level route override to pin tenant -> pool (server-side config) so control plane doesn't rely on headers. 2) Temporarily raise shared pool limits for affected tenant or increase acme-gold capacity. I'll do (1) now if ops approves.

alex-runtime: I'll draft a hotfix: parser should tolerate quoted values by stripping leading/trailing quotes before key=val parse. Patch + unit tests. But that requires a deploy to control plane; needs review.

maria-eng: Prioritize config mitigation first. Patch is low-risk but we should canary it.

kyle-sre: Actioning tenant override: `PATCH /internal/tenants/acme-inc/routing` -> `{ "pin_pool": "acme-gold", "force": true }` (ops only). Who can approve Ops change? @maria-eng?

maria-eng: Approve. Do it and let customer know.

infra-bot: Tenant override applied for acme-inc -> acme-gold (actor=kyle-sre) at 2024-12-07T09:58:03Z.

tom-cs: ACME confirms errors dropped immediately after override. They still see slight latency as backlog drains but 429s are gone. :tada:

ajane-support: Great. Next: schedule the parser fix and add a regression test for headers with embedded quotes and for common gateway encoders. Also add an ops dashboard alert if routing_evals_missing_tier > 0.5% for any tenant in a 5m window.

alex-runtime: I'll open a PR with the fix + tests. Plan: strip outer quotes, normalize whitespace, then parse key=val. Will canary in staging then prod.

maria-eng: Also add a note to deployment runbook: when gateway plugins are updated, run a quick smoke that validates routing headers for top 10 tenants.

kyle-sre: Filing incident ticket: INC-20241207-ACME-ROUTE. Will add timeline, mitigation, and RCA notes.

tom-cs: ACME wants to be notified when the platform patch is deployed. I'll keep them in the loop. Thanks all.

infra-bot: Incident INC-20241207-ACME-ROUTE created, priority P2, assignees: kyle-sre, alex-runtime, maria-eng.
